questions.markdown: Draw the VI characteristics of the Silicon diode. Explain the different types of breakdown mechanisms in a PN junction diode.

If a Silicon diode has a reverse saturation current of 20nA at $27^\circ$C, calculate the reverse current, forward current and dynamic resistance at $40^\circ$C when the diode is forward biased at 0.7V

Obtain an expression for the drain current of MOSFET in terms of $V_{GS}$, $V_{DS}$ and the dimension of the device. Also, plot the VI characteristics of the device indicating all the salient features on it.
Explain the operation of half wave rectifier with neat circuit and waveform. Derive an equation for $V_{dc}$, $V_{rms}$ and efficiency.
A full wave bridge rectifier with capacitor filter has $V_m = 8V$, $R_L = 100\Omega$, $C = 1000\mu F$ and $f = 50Hz$. Calculate the ripple factor and the DC output voltage.

A Zener regulator circuit has $V_Z = 20\,V$, $I_{Zmax} = 60\,mA$, $R_S = 220\Omega$ and $R_L = 1.2k\Omega$. Calculate the range of input voltage for which output will remain constant. Draw the circuit of a Zener voltage regulator and label all the components.

i) Represent $(0111)_2$ in the following codes:
a) Gray code b) $(7,4)$ even parity Hamming code

ii) Perform $(13.25)_{10} - (26.75)_{10}$ using 1's complement method.

Draw the circuit diagram of an OPAMP inverting amplifier and derive the expression for an output voltage. Given $R_F = 20k\Omega$, $R_1 = 4k\Omega$ and the dc supply voltage is $\pm 15V$. Calculate and plot the output voltage with respect to the input, if an input applied is $3\sin(2\pi1000t)$ Volt.

questions.markdown: Explain the Full adder circuit with a neat circuit diagram and truth table. Also obtain $(45)_{10}-(87)_{10}$ using 2's complement method.
Design a 2 bit Ripple up counter using positive edge triggered JK flipflop. Also sketch the timing diagram for the same.
Explain the operation of positive edge triggered SR flipflop using NAND gate with a neat circuit diagram and truth table. Also Realize D flipflop using SR flipflop.

Define Frequency Modulation (FM). Given a FM signal $V_{FM}(t) = 20\cos\left[2\Pi10^8t+5\sin(2\Pi15000t)\right]$, Calculate Carrier frequency, Modulating frequency, Frequency deviation and Bandwidth using Carson's rule.
Define sampling theorem. For an analog signal, $x(t)=3\cos100\pi t$. Determine the minimum sampling rate required to reconstruct the signal.
For the given binary data 1101 sketch the ASK, FSK and PSK waveforms.
